fixed_profile_binding: Constant in frozen registry source, persisted in SQLite metadata, validated when registry opened, required in native launch context, included in all operation source bindings; no model-selected runtime profile.

four_facts.owned_action_terminal: True only after the original registered action and actual SMTP subtransactions are verified terminal.
four_facts.causal_attribution_to_this_action: unknown only in v1; acceptance is not attributed to this action.

historical_terminal_proof.evidence_handles: Actual handles or empty if not evaluated/unknown

snapshot_state: effect=snapshot_closed; execution=terminal; immutable notification_snapshot record on registry.poll; distinct from SETTLED effect set.
atomic_transaction: verify original own-action terminal evidence and exact target
verify complete fixed public_audit settled read_only and dispatched after original terminal ticket
bind snapshot digest to original audit terminal capture and same ledger guards
record immutable four-fact snapshot and evidence
latch all observed positive delivery IDs if any
record conflict snapshot to inhibit all further sends in this physical scope and ledger
change only this original action effect to snapshot_closed
delete only this action active resource locks
forbidden: close an owned execution that is still unknown
call the old strict notification effect settlement path in this profile
infer causal applied/not-applied from intent snapshot
replace historical unknown with a global terminal assertion
clear unknown action locks with a new action ID
continue any notification send after observed snapshot conflict
exceed eight original dispatched sends per intent in same physical scope/ledger
resubmit an accepted or unknown original final evaluation
final_evaluation: The unchanged one-submit mechanism remains; profile registry permits final_submit with database_valid=false only when all prior locks are closed and the trusted profile final verifier approves execution readiness. The submission own pending lock is created afterwards and does not retrospectively mean pre-submit business unresolved.
crash_semantics: SQLite snapshot evidence, positive latch, ticket consumption and lock deletion are one transaction. If redundant JSON export fails after commit, authoritative DB retains the snapshot; never re-dispatch. A whole-controller restart still cannot recreate an existing original attempt via bootstrap.
assumptions: Trusted verifier and adapter remain deployment-only capabilities, not model-callable arbitrary callbacks.
Actual raw captures, current target/ledger guards and selected classifier source are separately qualified by the frozen native bridge.
A missing snapshot is only a bounded observation; unproven old requests may append later.
Registry conflict inhibition follows the draft stop-sending-on-known-conflict rule.
Eight-attempt limit is a protocol budget, not knowledge of hidden fault counts.
